scenarios.name: Provider outage or degradation
scenarios.objective: Fail closed within the bounded upstream deadline, return content-free diagnostics, and preserve usage evidence without forwarding employee credentials.
scenarios.production_gap: This local fake-provider timeout does not exercise live vendor status, production network controls, regional failover, or customer communications.

scenarios.name: Identity provider outage or signing-key failure
scenarios.objective: Reject an unavailable token exchange without issuing Hormuz credentials or leaving the enrollment redeemable.
scenarios.production_gap: This local OIDC simulation does not exercise a real identity provider, hosted discovery or key-cache behavior, emergency access, or workforce communications.

scenarios.name: Employee, provider, or signing credential compromise
scenarios.objective: Detect refresh-credential replay, revoke the entire session family, and retain tenant-scoped metadata without retaining raw credentials.
scenarios.production_gap: This local session-family exercise does not rotate provider or signing credentials in a shared KMS, revoke across replicas, or exercise external breach notification.

scenarios.name: Cross-tenant authorization or persistence disclosure
scenarios.objective: Keep session discovery and revocation scoped to the authenticated organization and retain only bounded metadata.
scenarios.production_gap: This SQLite application-scope regression is not production PostgreSQL RLS, cache-key isolation, multi-replica containment, or independent penetration evidence.

scenarios.name: Stale or unauthorized policy version reaches a gateway
scenarios.objective: Fail before provider egress when desired or active policy state is stale, unavailable, or corrupt.
scenarios.production_gap: The repository proves live versioned activation, rollback, and request-time fail-closed behavior; multi-replica production rollout, two-person approval, notification, and operator reconciliation exercises remain open.

scenarios.name: Unexpected token spend, budget bypass, or accounting drift
scenarios.objective: Deny a request before provider work when conservative reservation would exceed the organization budget and release no reservation leak.
scenarios.production_gap: This local budget gate does not exercise live provider billing lag, shared atomic reservations, invoice reconciliation, alert delivery, or finance escalation.

scenarios.name: Customer export, deletion, residency, or legal-hold request
scenarios.objective: Keep security and reservation records isolated to their owning organization before any tenant-scoped retention or deletion workflow is attempted.
scenarios.production_gap: This local isolation regression does not implement complete tenant erasure, usage and audit retention, backups, legal holds, provider-side data handling, residency, or deletion attestations.
